_help: Edit the values below. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Delete any key you don't need - defaults are used.
_appName: Name shown under the app icon
_appId: Unique Android package name, e.g. com.mycompany.myapp (change it for every different app)
_version: versionName is shown to users; versionCode must be a whole number that grows with every release
_apkName: Output file name without .apk (empty = taken from appName)
_url: Live website address to load, e.g. https://example.com (empty = bundle this repo's web files)
_webDir: Folder with the built site (empty = auto-detect dist, build, www, public, then repo root, then docs)
_buildCommand: Run before bundling if the site needs a build, e.g. npm ci && npm run build (then set webDir to dist)
_allowNavigation: Hosts the app may open inside itself; other links open in the browser. The host of url is added automatically. Wildcards work, e.g. *.example.com
_backgroundColor: Icon background and app background colour, e.g. #ffffff
_splashColor: Splash screen background colour while the app starts (empty = same as backgroundColor). Your icon.png is shown in the middle
_offlinePage: With url: show a No connection page with a retry button instead of a blank error screen (true or false)
